ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．

ex.t: 他们要求看看"奶奶的盒子"。

ex.s: What were the participants probably asked to do in the study?
ex.t: 参与者在研究中可能被要求做什么？

ex.t: 尽管____22____只要求成员接送学生上下课，威尔逊常常____23____以确保学生的福利和安全。

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: What was the beauty group asked to do with the clay objects?
ex.t: 美感组被要求对这些陶艺品做什么？

ex.s: Why was Addie asked to recite Longfellow’s poem to the Saturday evening’s club?
ex.t: 为什么阿迪被要求在周六晚上的俱乐部上朗诵朗费罗的诗？

ex.s: The goal of this book is to make the case for digital minimalism, including a detailed exploration of what it asks and why it works, and then to teach you how to adopt this philosophy if you decide it’s right for you.
ex.t: 这本书的目标是论证数字极简主义，包括详细探讨它的要求及其为何有效，然后教你如何采纳这一理念——如果你认定它适合你的话。

ex.s: For some terms, they simply copied out the correct definition; for others, they were asked to first add an error in their description of the term before  correcting the mistake.

ex.s: You will then be asked to take an ESL Placement Test The test results will help you choose the class that is appropriate for you.
ex.t: 然后你会被要求参加ESL分班测试。测试结果将帮助你选择适合你的班级。

ex.s: are asked to improve their English skills
ex.t: 被要求提高他们的英语技能。

ex.t: 每周，参与者将被要求完成一项特定主题的反思任务。

ex.s: “Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat,” Curtin says.
ex.t: “每个人都可以在减少浪费方面发挥作用，无论是在每周购物时不买超过需要的食物，还是要求餐厅不要上你不吃的配菜，”Curtin说。

ex.t: 然后我就努力回忆那些我 supposedly 收走的不同物品——因为我很少真正留下它们。

ex.s: The parents were asked to interact with their children as they normally would, and about half of children in the study played with puzzles at one time.
ex.t: 父母被要求像平时一样和孩子互动，研究中约一半的孩子曾同时玩拼图。

ex.s: Then, for eight years, the scientists asked the same group to come back to the lab every 18 months to take the same sorts of tests.

ex.s: There was a time when people may have felt awkward about asking for a table for one，but those days are over.
ex.t: 曾几何时，人们或许会因要求一张单人桌而感到尴尬，但那样的日子已经过去了。

ex.s: Before choices are finalized, parents / carers will be asked to sign to confirm their child’s choices.

ex.s: When I was 17， I read a magazine article about a museum called the McNay， once the home of a watercolorist named Marian McNay． She had requested the community to turn it into a museum upon her death． On a sunny Saturday， Sally and I drove over to the museum． She asked， "Do you have the address？ ""No， but I'll recognize it， there was a picture in the magazine．
ex.t: 我17岁时，读到一篇杂志文章，介绍一家叫麦克奈的博物馆，它曾是水彩画家玛丽安·麦克奈的故居。她曾要求社区在她去世后将其改为博物馆。一个阳光明媚的周六，萨莉和我开车去了博物馆。她问："你有地址吗？""没有，但我会认出来的，杂志上有照片。"

ex.s: The passages or conversation you will be asked several questions, the passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
ex.t: 你将针对短文或对话回答若干问题，短文和对话将读两遍，但问题只读一遍。

ex.s: As early as 1966, biologists asked the government to consider reintroducing wolves to Yellowstone Park.
ex.t: 早在1966年，生物学家就请求政府考虑将狼重新引入黄石公园。

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在Martin的研究中，她让参与者对一款名为“Miuu”的数字语音助手和自动驾驶汽车的有性别、女性、无性别版本评价自己的依恋程度。研究发现，性别增强了用户对这些设备的依恋感以及购买兴趣。

ex.s: They surveyed several hundred park-goers, asking them to submit a written summary online of a meaningful interaction they had with nature in the park.
ex.t: 他们调查了数百名公园游客，要求他们在线提交一份书面摘要，描述他们在公园里与大自然的某种有意义互动。

ex.s: As the kid, I loved to watch cartoons, but no matter how many times I asked to watching them, my parents would not to let me.
ex.t: 小时候，我喜欢看动画片，但无论我多少次要求看，我父母都不让我看。

ex.s: The Chinese asked them to kowtow to the Qianlong Emperor.
ex.t: 那么，马卡特尼没有达成贸易协议就离开中国也就不足为奇了。

ex.s: It would work like this: An officer arriving at the scene of a crash could ask for the phones of the drivers and use the Textalyzer to check in the operating system for recent activity.
ex.t: 它会这样运作：到达车祸现场的警官可以要求司机交出手机，并用Textalyzer在操作系统里检查近期活动。

ex.s: It may seem like a simple request to ask for salt and pepper at a meal
ex.t: 用餐时要求加盐和胡椒粉似乎是个简单的请求。

ex.s: To ask for permission.
ex.t: 请求许可。

ex.s: Sometimes, because a housewarming party happens shortly after a person moves into their new home, people may be asked to help unpack boxes.
ex.t: 有时候，因为一个人在搬进新家后不久就举行了房屋保暖派对，所以人们可能会被要求帮忙打开箱子。

ex.t: 我知道她是在征求意见。

ex.t: 向叔叔征求建议。

ex.s: Ask the audience to contribute their ideas or to take a role in explaining new concepts and policies to others.
ex.t: 请听众贡献想法，或让他们承担向他人解释新概念和新政策的角色。

ex.t: 我请姐姐帮我改正语法。

ex.t: 在对话结束时男士请女士做什么？

ex.t: 请美国总统帮个忙绝非小事，对一个17岁的女孩来说尤其如此。

ex.s: Asking for leave.
ex.t: C．请假。

ex.s: Fearing that I would pick out something awful, I desperately tried to ask the boy ahead of me for a recommendation.

ex.s: But that didn't stop China Daily from asking me last week to share a personal story for a video project about the integration of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei province.
ex.t: 但这并没有阻止《中国日报》上周邀请我为一个关于京津冀一体化的视频项目分享个人故事。

ex.s: Before the film began, each woman was asked to help herself to a snack.
ex.t: 电影开始前，每位女性都被邀请随意取用一份零食。

defs.def: to request a particular amount of money for sth that you are selling 要价；索价

ex.s: Most page turners are piano students or up-and-coming concert pianists, although Ms Raspopova has once asked her husband to help her out on stage.
ex.t: 大多数翻谱员是钢琴学生或崭露头角的音乐会钢琴家，尽管拉斯波波娃女士曾经让她丈夫在台上帮忙。

defs.def: to expect or demand sth 期望；要求

ex.s: In fact, in an interview, an important question to ask is: “ What would be expected of me as an employee?” In today's tough 'job market, young job seekers need to provide a potential employer with good reasons to hire them.
ex.t: 事实上，在面试中，一个要问的重要问题是：“作为雇员，我会被期望做什么？”在当今严峻的就业市场中，年轻的求职者需要向潜在雇主提供充分的理由来雇用他们。
